result.summary: The page mostly renders correctly, but the 'See all' links in the section headers are clipped at the right screen edge, which is a notable layout defect.

issues.description: The 'See all' links next to the 'Fastest near you' and 'Popular right now' section headings are clipped by the right edge of the screen, with the final letter partially cut off.
issues.suggestion: Ensure the section heading rows fit within the screen padding so that the 'See all' links are fully visible and not truncated.

issues.description: The category filter chip row appears to have a chip cut off at the right edge of the screen without enough visual indication that it can be scrolled.
issues.suggestion: Add a subtle gradient or shadow at the right edge to hint that more chips are available off-screen.
